evidence.title: Breaking Ground on Meta’s First Data Center in Canada

metadata.construction_wording_as_reported: We’re breaking ground on a new 1GW data center in Sturgeon County, Alberta
metadata.status_scope: The explicit breaking-ground disclosure supports one generic under_construction observation dated July 8, 2026. It does not establish a uniform foundations, shell, MEP, commissioning, completion, or operating substage.
metadata.scale_metric_guardrail: The page does not identify the reported 1 GW as critical IT load, gross facility demand, grid-connection capacity, generation nameplate, or current load. The claim remains evidence metadata and creates no typed capacity row.
metadata.workload_scope: Meta explicitly says the Sturgeon County data center will be optimized for its AI workloads. This supports only ai_specialized_unspecified, not training, inference, a customer workload, or a named model.
metadata.energy_infrastructure_context: Meta says it is fully funding new generation and grid infrastructure in Alberta to support the future data center.
metadata.energy_infrastructure_guardrail: Funding and planning generation and grid infrastructure do not establish a site generation asset, generation nameplate, grid-connection rating, installed equipment, current electricity supply, current load, or current energy consumption.
metadata.clean_energy_matching_scope: Meta says the data center’s future electricity use will be matched with 100% clean and renewable energy. This is a matching commitment, not a site generation mix, current energy measurement, PUE, annual consumption, or proof that the future facility is operating.
metadata.future_operation_guardrail: Forecast construction employment, future operational jobs, once-complete investment, and cooling-design descriptions do not establish completion or operation.
metadata.annual_disclosure_guardrail: The statement that Meta discloses facility energy use annually supplies no Sturgeon-specific measurement in this page and cannot support an annual-energy estimate.
metadata.coordinate_guardrail: Sturgeon County, Alberta is an authoritative locality only, not a street address, parcel, footprint, building centroid, survey point, or geocode. Coordinates and geometry remain null.
